reviews.comment: Best diff eq prof. Lectures were super helpful because he worked out problems step by step. Tests were exactly like the homework and the test reviews, which he provides before each test. Professor Chen also holds office hours which are very helpful if you need help. TAKE HIM FOR A FREE CLASS!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Homework is based off the lecture notes, and the midterm/final is based on the review he posts one week before. Very clear on what is going to be on the test, and is a great lecturer as well. Posts lecture notes on canvas that are honestly even more detailed than what he goes over in class, showing all work in case you didn't understand something.
He simply is the goat. Do the reviews before the tests and you should be good. He also curved my final grade at the end.
Chen Liewei is the goat, that is all.

Best prof I've had at A&M. Does a wonderful job of explaining things in lecture. Grades easy on homework. Posts lecture notes. He also gives test reviews which are exactly like the test, so if you put in the work it's not difficult to get an A. Great experience all around.

Dr.Chen is a great professor, the assignments are doable and the tests are on par with the reviews that he provides. His lectures are great so definitely try to go to them, he also posts the lecture notes which are helpful. Overall 10/10 prof, would recommend to anyone.

Good lectures that were very simple, covering examples that were similar to the homework and tests. Homework is very light compared to experiences with all previous math classes. Tests come with a really good exam review he releases a week earlier that covers everything for a test really well with finished examples. Generous partial credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Probably the best prof I've ever had. Has great lectures and notes, provides detailed review sheets before exams, and make a difficult class fairly easy and understandable. If you have the opportunity to take him, TAKE HIM.

I was wary of him at first, because I didn't follow along well in his lectures. However, I soon after found that he was kind and caring, while providing everything that I needed to succeed. His written reviews before the tests are basically all you need to complete to get an A, and he seems to genuinely care about his students.

Dr. Chen goes over great examples in class so while attendence isn't mandatory I'd heavily encourage it. DE isn't an easy subject so don't think because he's a relaxed prof that you can get behind & cram for exams. Homework & study guides are extremely similar to the exams & he makes a study guide for every exam!

What a prof! I cannot remember if I had a better teacher. Gave detailed test reviews before each test and the exams were from it. The lectures were super amazing and would always review what we did the day before before beginning with new content. Absolute G of a prof. Take him

Professor Chen was a great professor. He seemed very caring and knew the subject very well. He always made sure to ask if anyone had any questions and answered them very well. The class is very test heavy, but they can be practiced online. He always posts his lectures online, so attendance is not mandatory. Great guy in general. Highly recommend.

Dr. Chen is an amazing lecturer and lenient grader. He cares about his students and answers questions patiently even if they are about past topics. He is very helpful during office hours. He gives out detailed exam reviews and the exams are basically the same questions. He posts lecture notes and gives extra optional readings for those interested.
